presentation.slice: 0–8 m voxel mean centred at 4 m; not pedestrian breathing height

emission_mapping.policy: SUMO road z plus assumed 1m exhaust height; nearest fluid cell at the same vertical layer within 16m. Explicit preview exclusions only.

assumptions: Frozen recorded wind at its declared model time; new conditional traffic scenario, not a simultaneous observation.
SUMO exhaust PMx increment only; zero initial/background increment; not total measured PM2.5.
Constant effective diffusivity; no chemistry, deposition, non-exhaust PM or calibrated turbulence.
8 m voxel mean is not a resolved pedestrian breathing-height concentration.
Excluded source contributions are unavailable, not zero; downwind concentration is incomplete when partial_preview is true.
